sources.entry: Shuffle - Fast, GPU-rendered file manager and Finder alternative built in Rust with GPUI, featuring dual panes, tabs, a fuzzy command palette, terminal mode, and theming.

summary.one_liner: Shuffle is an open source, GPU-rendered file manager for macOS written in Rust with GPUI, offering dual panes, tabs, a fuzzy command palette, optional terminal mode, and theming.
summary.what_it_does: Shuffle is a macOS file explorer intended as an alternative to Finder, inspired by File Pilot on Windows. It renders its UI on the GPU via Metal and virtualizes lists so large folders scroll smoothly. Users can split the window into side-by-side panes, each with its own tabs, history, and filter, and open tabs with Cmd+T. The command palette (Cmd+P) provides fuzzy search over the home directory with typo tolerance, live path browsing, and quick commands. An optional terminal mode adds a shell-like command bar where cd navigates and Tab autocompletes paths and commands. Single-clicking a file can show a QuickLook preview and an inspector panel, and cloud folders such as Dropbox, Google Drive, OneDrive, and iCloud appear automatically along with a Connect to Server dialog. A theme system offers preset palettes (Catppuccin, Dracula, Nord, Gruvbox, Solarized, Tokyo Night) and per-color customization.
use_cases: replace Finder with a faster file browser on mac
split view file management with side-by-side panes
navigate folders from a keyboard or shell-like command bar
quickly find files by fuzzy name search
preview files with QuickLook while browsing
customize file manager colors and themes
notable: GPU-rendered Metal UI with fully virtualized lists for very large directories
Dual panes created by dragging a tab to a window edge, with a draggable divider
Fuzzy command palette (Cmd+P) with typo tolerance and live path browsing
Optional terminal mode where cd navigates and Tab autocompletes
Deep theming with dozens of presets and per-color customization applied live
caveats: macOS only; requires macOS 12 or later
Intel builds are only available from source
README describes the project as early but usable and under active development
keywords: speed up file browsing on mac
